people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: They judged the people at all times. They brought the hard cases to Moses, but every small matter they judged themselves.
translations.bsb: And they judged the people at all times; they would bring the difficult cases to Moses, but any minor issue they would judge themselves.
